problem.title: Loyalty Members Meeting Multi-Month Spending Thresholds
problem.prompt: A beauty retailer tracks loyalty program member purchases in the `redemption_activity` table. Each row records one transaction with the member ID, transaction month, and points redeemed. Management wants to identify members who met BOTH of the following criteria: (1) redeemed at least 500 points during January 2024, AND (2) redeemed at least 500 points during February 2024. A member qualifies only if they clear both monthly thresholds; partial qualification does not count. Return columns `member_id` and `total_points_redeemed` (the sum across all months for that member). Order the result by `member_id` ascending. Note that some members may have activity in only one month, and some months may have zero activity for a given member.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE redemption_activity (activity_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, member_id INT NOT NULL, transaction_month DATE NOT NULL, points_redeemed INT NOT NULL);

composite_moves: group-aggregate with conditional sums per slice

hints: You need to check whether each member hit a threshold in two different months.
Use GROUP BY member_id with conditional aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN points_redeemed ELSE 0 END) for each month.
In the HAVING clause, require that the January sum >= 500 AND the February sum >= 500, then also SELECT the overall SUM(points_redeemed) as total_points_redeemed.
problem.answer_key: SELECT member_id, SUM(points_redeemed) AS total_points_redeemed FROM redemption_activity GROUP BY member_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_month) = DATE '2024-01-01' THEN points_redeemed ELSE 0 END) >= 500 AND SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_month) = DATE '2024-02-01' THEN points_redeemed ELSE 0 END) >= 500 ORDER BY member_id;

_meta.scenario: a beauty retailer tracking loyalty program redemption rates

user_solution:
SELECT
    member_id,
    SUM(points_redeemed) AS total_points_redeemed
FROM redemption_activity 
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_month >= '2024-01-01' AND
            transaction_month < '2024-02-01' THEN points_redeemed END) >= 500 AND
        SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_month >= '2024-02-01' AND
            transaction_month < '2024-03-01' THEN points_redeemed END) >= 500
ORDER BY member_id;
